title: docs: allow branches for requested PRs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Treats an explicit PR request as approval to create its focused branch
- Keeps separate approval for unrequested branch or PR changes
- Removes the redundant follow-up approval prompt

gist.headline: Branches, With Permission
gist.blurb: The contributor guide now recognizes a useful little fact: asking for a PR is also asking for the branch it needs. One less ceremonial nod before the work can begin.
gist.summary: Updated AGENTS.md so an explicit request for a pull request also authorizes creating its focused branch, while unrequested branch or PR changes still require separate approval.
gist.impact: Contributors and agents can move from an approved PR request to a focused branch without a redundant follow-up confirmation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny gardener placing an approved seed labeled “PR” into a branching code-plant pot; the requested branch grows naturally from the seed while a separate locked side branch represents changes that still need approval. Use a cozy documentation/workflow scene with a small retro terminal and flowers.
